svg.title: Жим гантелей нейтральным хватом — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. True hammer neutral-grip standing dumbbell overhead press. Use front-left oblique view at about 45 degrees so the two dumbbell axles point forward/back from the athlete and slope diagonally in perspective. In BOTH poses hands stay turned so the palms face each other (left palm points right and right palm points left), thumbs toward athlete's own face. Keep BOTH dumbbell axle/handle lines sagittal, visibly oriented front-to-back, parallel to the direction the face points. Do not align the axles left-to-right along the shoulder line. Left figure begins with elbows bent forward a little and two dumbbells at ears; right finishes with dumbbells overhead, same palms-in grip. Both figures stand. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
